main_text.head: TERTIO. Omnium figurarum solidarum
main_text.p: & ad motum est aptissima, & mobilitate celerrima sphærica. Nil enim asperitatis habet, nil offensionis, nil incisum angulis aut anfractibus, nil eminens aut lacunosum. At cœlum uelocißime & facillime circumuolitur. Admirabili enim celeritate conuerti & constantißime uicißitudines diurnas conficere 24 horarum spacio cernimus, nec in eo motu impingit uspiam. Mouetur ergo in orbem.
main_text.head: QVARTO. Primo & perfectißimo corpori conuenit prima & perfectißima figura.
main_text.p: Cœlum omnium corporum est primum et perfectißimum. Omnium uero figurarum solidarum prima

page.notes: Four woodcut diagrams above the text: upper left a hexagon in a circle, upper right a square in a circle, lower left a pentagon in a circle, lower right a triangle in a circle, each with dark triangular segments between the polygon and the circle.
